source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "right to the city" AND ("public space" OR street OR streets)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"right to the city" AND ("public space" OR street OR streets),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("right to the city" AND ("public space" OR "street" OR "streets"))
